title: Cathedral of Notre Dame
summary: The Cathedral of Notre Dame, located in Paris, France, is a National monument and major tourist attraction whilst also serving as a Huntik Foundation base. It proved key to locating the entrance to the Paris Catacombs and the Ring of Arc.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The cathedral has been a base of the Huntik Foundation operations for decades. One of the gargoyles faces the abandoned church in Paris which hides the entrance to the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs]

The Ring of Arc was kept in the Cathedral of Notre Dame, watched over by Clements. [Divide and Conquer]

When the Titan of Fate, Arc became active, Clements went missing while the possessed Freelancer, Hoplite and Ironsquire atacked tourists outside the Cathedral. The Huntik team dealt with the Titans and adventured into the Catacombs. After Arc was defeated, Clements returned to the base whilst Zhalia helped Metz with a cover story for the Titan altercation. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

full_text:
The Cathedral of Notre Dame, located in Paris, France, is a National monument and major tourist attraction whilst also serving as a Huntik Foundation base. It proved key to locating the entrance to the Paris Catacombs and the Ring of Arc.

== History ==
The cathedral has been a base of the Huntik Foundation operations for decades. One of the gargoyles faces the abandoned church in Paris which hides the entrance to the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs]

The Ring of Arc was kept in the Cathedral of Notre Dame, watched over by Clements. [Divide and Conquer]

When the Titan of Fate, Arc became active, Clements went missing while the possessed Freelancer, Hoplite and Ironsquire atacked tourists outside the Cathedral. The Huntik team dealt with the Titans and adventured into the Catacombs. After Arc was defeated, Clements returned to the base whilst Zhalia helped Metz with a cover story for the Titan altercation. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]
